preconditions.name: decomp_samples_sufficient
preconditions.description: genuine fresh E3 selections per cell (latch-gated, never per-env-step) -- the true denominator behind every variance share
preconditions.control: worst cell across the VERDICT-BEARING arms (A0, A1)

preconditions.name: committed_total_variance_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: sum of per-component variances at the committed candidate -- literally the denominator the load-bearing share criterion divides by
preconditions.control: worst cell across the VERDICT-BEARING arms (A0, A1)

preconditions.name: clamp_config_landed_every_cell
preconditions.description: the clamp flag actually reached agent.e2.config in every cell and matches the arm's request (REEConfig.from_dims swallows unknown kwargs silently, so this is the only proof the manipulation exists)
preconditions.control: all cells; 1.0 = every cell's live clamp equals its arm spec

interpretation.combination_rule: C1 alone routes the verdict (load-bearing). C2 refines WHICH channel holds a monopoly C1 found; C3 is descriptive attribution of any change to the clamp. C2 and C3 never override C1.
